battle.name: 莫何可汗擊阿波可汗之戰
battle.brief: 開皇七年，莫何可汗於陰山擊敗阿波可汗，阿波東走鐵勒，被追殺於沙磧。此役後莫哈自即大汗位，控弦二十餘萬，鐵勒諸部盡歸其下。卡面羅馬重步兵是對照件：一邊靠補充兵源與補給線維持陣形，一邊靠馬群與牲畜續命，決定戰果的其實是沙磧裡斷絕草水的那段路。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 這是東突厥汗國的一場內戰，時間在公元587年，即隋文帝開皇七年，交戰雙方並非兩個國家，而是同出一源的兩位可汗。東突厥自550年代立國，牙庭設於漠北，可汗直轄十牙部眾，此外有鐵勒等附屬部眾向可汗朝貢、出兵與交納馬匹。開皇七年的一方是莫何可汗，他與阿波可汗是同族近親，一度同在白道（今內蒙古呼和浩特西南的白道城）附近起帳，據有部分部眾與鐵勒牧場；另一方是阿波可汗，掌握原有牙庭的直屬部眾，得到北方諸部與部分鐵勒部眾的支持，兵眾駐於漠南陰山一帶。第三方是鐵勒聯盟，含韋紇、契苾、骨咄、紇利、思摩等部，分布於漠北東部與陰山以北，突厥崛起之後成為汗國的附屬與支柱；阿波敗走後是他們收容了阿波，而莫何追入沙磧之後，最後動手的也是他們。南方是隋朝，開皇三年大破沙鉢略可汗之後轉為守勢，築長城、封可汗、遣使往來並行，587年正是隋在北方邊境築城最勤的一年，東突厥的內訌與互併，讓隋的北疆從此前線變成有隙可乘。
countriesEn: This was a civil war inside the Eastern Turkic Khaganate, fought in 587 CE, the seventh year of the Kaihuang reign of Emperor Wen of Sui. The two sides were not two states but two khagans of a single lineage. The Eastern Turkic state had been founded in the 550s with its great tent in the northern steppe; the khagan directly commanded the ten divisions of the tribal confederation, and beyond them the Tiele and other dependent peoples paid tribute, furnished troops and delivered horses. One party in 587 was Mohe, or Muqan, Qaghan, a close kinsman of Apu Qaghan; the two had dwelt together in the vicinity of Baidao, the white road, at the site of Baidao city south-west of Hohhot in Inner Mongolia, holding a share of the people and of the Tiele pastures. The other was Apu Qaghan, who held the khagan's own direct divisions and enjoyed the support of the northern peoples and of part of the Tiele, with his riders posted around the Yin Mountains of southern Mongolia. The third party was the Tiele confederation, made up of tribes such as the Ywei, the Qiebi, the Gudu, the Heli and the Simo, spread across the eastern steppe and north of the Yin Mountains, and after the rise of the Turks they became the dependents and pillars of the khanate. It was the Tiele who took in Apu after his defeat, and the Tiele who struck the last blow when Mohe chased him into the sandy wastes. To the south lay the Sui dynasty, which after breaking Shabqlio Qaghan in 583 turned to the defensive, building walls on the northern frontier, bestowing investiture on khagans and exchanging envoys in parallel. The year 587 was the busiest year for Sui construction on the northern border, and the civil war and mutual annexation inside the Eastern Turks turned that border from a continuous line into a seam that could be exploited.
people: 這場戰爭留下的記錄極簡：史書沒有為陰山之役記下一位雙方的主將姓名，能確認的只有兩位可汗的身分與去向。莫何可汗是開皇年間東突厥的實際掌權者，據《隋書》，他早年與阿波可汗同處白道，開皇七年主動出擊，取勝之後自即大汗位；開皇九年（589）他迎娶隋宗女安義公主，開皇十五年（595）請隋出師攻打吐谷渾，途中病卒，年數十餘歲，身後由弟弟突利可汗繼位，突利後來率眾投隋，被娶以義成公主。可汗的對頭阿波可汗是前一任可汗沙鉢略的同族，開皇三年沙鉢略大敗於隋軍之後，同族之中多部倒向隋，開皇七年阿波在陰山被莫何擊敗，東走鐵勒，最終死於追擊途中的沙磧。沙鉢略可汗本身也是這條因果鏈上的一環，他於開皇七年死於非命，身後留下一片真空。隋朝方面，站在局外看的是隋文帝楊堅與他的謀臣：開皇十年（590）長孫晟提出離間突厥諸可汗之策，用的是收買、冊封與部落之間的利害差異；開皇七年到九年，隋的北方邊將韋馭、楊爽等人一面築城一面備戰，正是靠突厥內部的分裂才有可守之界。鐵勒諸部的首領在史冊上沒有留下姓名，但殺死阿波的是他們，這是這場戰爭裡最耐人尋味的一幕。
peopleEn: The record of this war is very thin: no chronicler preserved the name of a single commander on either side at the Yin Mountains, and what can be confirmed is only the identity and the fate of the two khagans. Mohe, or Muqan, Qaghan was the effective ruler of the Eastern Turks during the Kaihuang years. According to the History of Sui, he dwelt with Apu Qaghan at Baidao in his early years, struck first in 587, and after winning took for himself the title of Great Qaghan. In 589, the ninth year of Kaihuang, he received the Sui princess An-Yi in marriage; in 595, the fifteenth year, he asked the Sui to send troops against the Tuyuhun, and he fell ill and died on the way, still in his fifties. He was succeeded by his younger brother Tuli Qaghan, who later led his people over to the Sui and was given the princess I-Cheng in marriage. Apu Qaghan, the opponent, was a kinsman of the preceding khagan Shabqlio; after Shabqlio was badly beaten by the Sui army in 583, many of the kinsmen's divisions went over to the Sui, and in 587 Apu was defeated by Mohe at the Yin Mountains, fled east to the Tiele, and died in the sands during the pursuit. Shabqlio Qaghan himself is also a link in this chain of cause and effect: he died violently in 587 and left a vacuum behind him. On the Sui side, the spectator was Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, and his advisers. In 590, the tenth year of Kaihuang, Zhangsun Sheng proposed a policy of sowing division among the Turkic khagans, using bribes, investiture and the divergent interests of the tribes. Between 587 and 589 the northern frontier commanders of the Sui, Wei Fu and Yang Shuang, built walls and prepared the defence at the same time, and they had a border worth holding only because of the split inside the Turks. The names of the Tiele chiefs do not survive in the annals, but it was the Tiele who killed Apu, and that is the most telling detail in the whole war.
kits: 卡面是羅馬重步兵：一副分段鎧甲、一面重盾、一支標槍與一柄短劍，是西方重裝步兵最典型的形象，年份定在公元前100年，正落在羅馬共和國中期的軍制上。必須先講清楚它在本役的位置：587年的陰山與沙磧裡沒有任何一個羅馬兵，也沒有任何一面羅馬盾，這件兵器在這場戰爭中是對照件，不是戰場實物。它真正可以借鑑的，是卡面那句話——羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。東突厥的全部戰力是一支不落地的騎兵，沒有步兵方陣，沒有可以固守的營壘，兵員補充靠的是部眾的附屬與歸附，而不是徵兵制；補給線在草原上等同於馬群、牲畜與牧場。因此莫何可汗的取勝之道，同羅馬帝國在邊疆上對付游牧者的邏輯完全一致：不是比誰的甲更厚，而是比誰先把對方的馬群與草場耗掉。陰山接戰之後，他沒有在原地列陣求決、收拾繳獲，而是咬住不放，長驅東進，把戰場從陰山一帶的水草之地拖進北方大漠的沙磧。實際的戰時裝備另有一套：札弓與角弓這類複合反弓，配骨鏃或鐵鏃箭矢；札甲與魚鱗甲，配皮甲與獸皮披掛；頭上是出土於蒙古高原的骨盔，配毛皮護耳；近身是長柄矛、直刃環首刀與短劍，騎手另備小圓盾。馬具方面，五至六世紀的墓葬已出土高鞍與馬鐙，正是東突厥騎兵能縱馬衝鋒與在馬上張弓的技術前提。帳幕、鼓旗、炊具與肉食隨帳而行，駝馬與牛群跟在後面充當載重與口糧來源。羅馬的投槍、劍與盾在這裡沒有對應物；草原的對應物只有弓弦與馬蹄。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman legionary: a set of segmented armour, a heavy shield, a javelin and a short sword, the most typical image of heavy infantry in the West, dated to 100 BC, which lands squarely on the army of the middle Roman Republic. Its position in this campaign has to be stated plainly first: in 587 there was not a single Roman soldier at the Yin Mountains or in the sands, and not a single Roman shield, so in this war the weapon is a reference piece and not a piece of the field. What it can really lend is the sentence on the card: Rome's strength lay in replenishing men and in the supply line, not in heavy equipment. The entire fighting force of the Eastern Turks was a cavalry that never dismounted, with no infantry square, no fixed camp to hold, and no manumission system to draw replacements on; the men were replaced by the submission and defection of tribes, and the supply line on the steppe was the horse herds, the livestock and the pastures. The logic by which Mohe Qaghan won was therefore identical to the logic by which the Roman Empire handled pastoral peoples on its frontiers: not a contest over which side had thicker armour, but a contest over who could exhaust the enemy's horses and grazing first. After the contact at the Yin Mountains he did not stand and fight it out, nor stop to collect the booty; he held on, drove east at length, and pulled the battlefield out of the watered country around the Yin Mountains and into the sandy wastes of the northern desert. The actual equipment of the time was a different set: composite recurved bows of horn and sinew, with arrows carrying bone or iron heads; lamellar and scale armour, with leather cuirasses and hides thrown over the shoulder; bone helmets excavated from the Mongolian plateau, with fur ear-flaps; long spears, straight-bladed ring-pommel knives and swords at close quarters, and small round shields for the riders. As for horse gear, high saddles and stirrups are already attested in burials of the fifth and sixth centuries, and they are the technical precondition for the Turkic horseman to charge at full gallop and shoot from the saddle. Tents, drums, banners, cooking gear and meat travelled with the camp, with camels and cattle following behind as pack and ration. The Roman pilum, sword and shield have no counterpart here; the steppe's counterparts are the bowstring and the hoof.
tactics: 陰山之役的具體過程，史書只留下骨架：莫何擊阿波於陰山，阿波敗走，東奔鐵勒，莫何追之，及於沙磧，殺之。從草原戰爭的常規推敲，這是一場典型的追擊殲滅戰，裡面有三個動作。第一步是試探與合併：阿波與莫何同居白道，名義上同屬一族，兵眾同樣是弓騎手，任何一方想單靠正面硬撼都難有必勝把握，於是雙方都在等對方露出縱隊拉長與陣形散亂的破綻。第二步是在陰山擇地接戰：草原騎兵不追求列陣對列陣，而是以散兵線互相試探、繞射，掩護一支部隊衝鋒，兩翼同時拉出來切割；雙方的勝負往往不在一次衝撞，而在誰先把陣形拉散。第三步最關鍵——莫何沒有在陰山停下來收兵，而是咬住不放，長驅東進，把戰場從陰山一帶的水草之地拖進北方大漠的沙磧。沙磧無草無水，馬群失飼，阿波可汗的騎兵在飢渴中崩潰，最後殺他的是隨行的鐵勒人。從羅馬的角度看，這正好是重步兵靠補給線那條規矩的反面：羅馬的軍團離開營地與道路太遠就會失去戰力，草原的騎兵同樣離不開馬群與草場，只是那條補給線是移動的，敵人可以用追擊把它燒掉。整場戰爭的勝負手不在交鋒的那一瞬間，而在戰後誰還有馬可以騎。
tacticsEn: The course of the battle at the Yin Mountains survives only as a skeleton: Mohe struck Apu at the Yin Mountains, Apu was defeated and fled east to the Tiele, Mohe pursued him, and overtook him in the sandy wastes and killed him. Judged against the regular practice of steppe warfare, this was a typical pursuit and destruction, and it contains three actions. The first was testing and closing: Apu and Mohe dwelt together at Baidao, belonged nominally to the same lineage, and their troops were bow-armed horsemen of the same kind, so neither could expect a sure victory from a straight frontal clash alone; each was waiting for the other to show a broken formation and a column stretched out of order. The second was to choose the ground and make contact at the Yin Mountains: steppe cavalry did not aim at line against line, but probed with loose order, shot around the flanks and covered the charge of one body while both wings were drawn out to cut in; the result was usually decided less by one impact than by who broke the other side's order first. The third and decisive step was that Mohe did not stop at the Yin Mountains to gather in his men; he held on, drove east at length, and pulled the battlefield out of the watered country around the Yin Mountains into the sandy wastes of the northern desert. There was no grass and no water in those sands, the horse herds lost their fodder, Apu Qaghan's riders broke up under hunger and thirst, and the man who finally killed him was a Tiele riding with the pursuers. From the Roman point of view this is exactly the reverse of the rule that heavy infantry depends on its supply line: a Roman legion that strayed too far from its camp and its roads lost its power, and the steppe horseman was just as dependent on horses and grazing, except that his supply line moved, and an enemy could burn it by pursuit. The whole war was not decided at the moment of contact but by who still had horses to ride afterwards.
data: 關於這場戰爭的數字，要分清哪些有出處、哪些只是量級的估計。年代最確定：開皇七年，即公元587年，隋文帝在位時。地理上，陰山指今內蒙古中部的陰山山脈，也就是呼和浩特至包頭一線的南北山地；白道在呼和浩特西南；阿波被殺的沙磧在漠北東部的大沙漠地帶。從陰山到沙磧，以千餘里的騎程計，縱騎疾行也要以週計，而史書沒有記下追擊究竟用了多少天。兵員方面，東突厥全汗國的兵眾在《隋書》裡常被記作控弦二十餘萬，這是隋廷對整個汗國的估計，包含各牙帳與附屬，並非陰山一役的實數；阿波一方的兵力、雙方的傷亡與俘虜數，漢文史料完全沒有留下；近代學者對鐵勒各部兵力的常見估計落在數萬的量級，那也只是量級。可以確認的另一組數字是隋朝方面的內附紀錄：開皇三年之後，突厥諸部陸續內附，隋廷收容的丁口以萬計，其人數與編組在《隋書》裡分散於各條記載，總數當在數萬以上。真正精確的只有時間順序：沙鉢略死、阿波即位與戰敗、莫何自稱大汗、突利繼位，四個節點先後清楚。月份則是史書缺載的一項，卡上所標的月份只能按草原春末夏初的用兵季節推估。
dataEn: On the numbers for this war, one has to separate what is attested from what is merely an order of magnitude. The date is the firmest thing: 587 CE, the seventh year of Kaihuang, in the reign of Emperor Wen of Sui. Geographically, the Yin Mountains are the Yinshan range across central Inner Mongolia, the line of high ground north and south of the corridor between Hohhot and Baotou; Baidao lies south-west of Hohhot; and the sands where Apu was killed lie in the great desert country of the eastern northern steppe. From the Yin Mountains to those sands is a ride of more than a thousand li, which even at a hard gallop takes weeks, and the chronicles do not record how many days the pursuit lasted. On strength, the troops of the Eastern Turkic state as a whole are recorded in the History of Sui as controlling more than two hundred thousand bowstrings; that is a Sui estimate of the entire khanate, covering all divisions and dependents, and not a return for the battle at the Yin Mountains. The size of Apu's force, and the losses and prisoners on both sides, do not survive in the Chinese sources at all; the usual modern estimates for the Tiele tribes fall in the tens of thousands, and that too is an order of magnitude. A second body of figures can be confirmed on the Sui side: after 583 the Turkic divisions came over to the Sui in succession, and the Sui court took in populations counted in tens of thousands, the numbers and their organisation scattered across various entries of the History of Sui, the total certainly in the high tens of thousands. What is genuinely precise is the sequence of events: the death of Shabqlio, the accession and defeat of Apu, Mohe's assumption of the title of Great Qaghan, and the accession of Tuli. The month is one item the chronicles do not supply, and the month marked on the card can only be an estimate from the campaigning season of the late spring and early summer on the steppe.
cause: 打起來的直接原因是汗位與部眾的分配，但根子在一個正在崩解的汗國。東突厥自佗斤可汗之時已經內訌不絕，紇干可汗奪位、沙鉢略可汗反殺奪位，權威靠一次次弒逆維持，等到開皇三年（583）隋軍深入漠南、在陰山與曼周山一帶重創沙鉢略，突厥汗系的威信就此斷裂：可汗的直屬部眾大量逃散或內附，各鐵勒部與小可汗各自為政，白道成了雙方都能伸手的地方。於是出現了這樣的局面：阿波可汗與莫何可汗是同族近親，同在白道附近，兩邊各握一部分帳帳與兵眾，名義上仍是同一個汗國的兩位可汗，實際上已經是兩支聯軍。開皇七年爆發的正是這場爭奪的第二輪激化，直接由誰先動手決定。此外還有兩股外力把矛盾推高：一是隋朝，開皇三年之後在邊境築長城、封可汗、遣使往來，把突厥可汗這個名號變成可以用利益交換的籌碼；二是草原經濟本身，鐵勒諸部掌握著東部的牧場與最好的戰馬，控制了鐵勒就等於控制兵源，控制了兵源就等於控制汗位。莫何與阿波爭的表面是白道，底下爭的是鐵勒。
causeEn: The direct cause was the apportionment of the khanship and of the people, but the root lay in a khanate that was coming apart. From the time of Tuo-jin Qaghan the Eastern Turks had been torn by internecine strife: Hedun Qaghan seized the throne and Shabqlio Qaghan killed him and seized it in turn, so that authority was maintained by a series of regicides. By 583, the seventh year of Kaihuang, when the Sui army pushed deep into southern Mongolia and crushed Shabqlio around the Yin Mountains and the Moun Zhou Mountain area, the prestige of the Turkic ruling line broke outright: large numbers of the khagan's own divisions scattered or came over to the Sui, the Tiele tribes and the lesser khagans each ruled themselves, and Baidao became a place where both parties could put out a hand. The result was this: Apu Qaghan and Mohe Qaghan were close kinsmen dwelling near one another at Baidao, each holding a share of the tents and the men; nominally they were still two khagans of one khanate, and in practice they were already two coalitions. What broke out in 587 was the second and sharper round of that struggle, and it was decided by who struck first. Two outside forces pushed the contradiction higher besides: the Sui, which after 883 built long walls on the border, invested khagans and exchanged envoys, turning the title of Turkic khagan into a bargaining chip that could be traded for profit; and the steppe economy itself, since the Tiele tribes held the eastern pastures and the best horses, so that control of the Tiele was control of the source of troops, and control of the troops was control of the khanship. On the surface Mohe and Apu were fighting for Baidao; underneath they were fighting for the Tiele.
impact: 這場內戰的直接結果是東突厥在莫何手上重新統一，而這個統一反過來成了隋朝北疆的壓力。開皇七年之後，莫何以大汗之名收攏阿波餘眾與鐵勒諸部，控弦之數被隋廷估到二十餘萬；開皇九年（589）隋文帝以宗女安義公主嫁莫何，遣使至其牙帳，這是隋第一次以正式婚姻承認一位東突厥大汗的地位，莫何也藉此換得南方王朝的認可與物資。開皇十年（590）長孫晟獻離間之策，用的正是鐵勒與汗族之間、兄弟之間的裂縫；日後可汗兄弟相殘，突利可汗於開皇十九年（599）率眾投隋，隋得以用聯姻與內應逐一拆解突厥，終於在開皇末年把沙鉢略可汗的體系徹底清除。也就是說，587年莫何用刀兵解決的問題，八年後被隋朝用外交解決，而兩者用的是同一條裂縫。更長遠地看，這場戰爭是漢文史料與草原碑銘互證的一個樣本：隋書留下了結果，後來立於唐代的突厥碑銘與蒙古高原出土的骨甲、馬具，則補上了器械與風俗的另一面。它也標誌著草原權力結構的一次轉向——鐵勒諸部從突厥的附屬者，變成突厥汗國的組成部分，而回鶻、契苾這些名字此後會在更大的歷史裡出現。
impactEn: The direct outcome of this civil war was the reunification of the Eastern Turks under Mohe, and that reunification in turn became the pressure on Sui's northern frontier. After 587 Mohe gathered in Apu's remnants and the Tiele tribes under the title of Great Qaghan, and the number of bowstrings under him was estimated by the Sui court at more than two hundred thousand. In 589, the ninth year of Kaihuang, Emperor Wen of Sui married the Sui princess An-Yi to Mohe and sent an embassy to his tent; this was the first time the Sui acknowledged the position of an Eastern Turkic Great Qaghan through a formal marriage, and Mohe in return obtained the recognition and the goods of the southern dynasty. In 590, the tenth year, Zhangsun Sheng proposed the policy of division, using precisely the cracks between the Tiele and the ruling line and between brothers. Later the khagans destroyed one another, Tuli Qaghan led his people to the Sui in 599, and the Sui was able to take the Turks apart one by one with marriages and defectors, until in the last years of Kaihuang the whole system of Shabqlio Qaghan was cleared away. In other words, the problem Mohe solved by force in 587 was solved by Sui diplomacy eight years later, and both used the same fissure. In the longer run this war is a case of Chinese written sources and steppe inscriptions corroborating each other: the History of Sui preserves the result, while the Turkic stelae raised in Tang times and the bone helmets and horse gear excavated from the Mongolian plateau supply the other half of the picture, the equipment and the customs. It also marks a turning point in the structure of steppe power: the Tiele tribes ceased to be dependents of the Turks and became components of the Turkic khanate, and the names Ywei and Qiebi would go on to appear in a much larger history.
result: 陰山之役的結局是徹底的：莫何可汗勝，阿波可汗敗走東投鐵勒，追擊一直打到北方大漠的沙磧，阿波死在那裡，餘眾與所部歸於莫何。此後莫何自居大汗，收攏鐵勒諸部，把汗國的權力重新收在一個可汗與他的兄弟手上，這是自佗斤以來東突厥最完整的一次整合。但整合的代價在史書裡也看得到：開皇十五年（595）莫何請隋出師伐吐谷渾，途中病卒，汗位由弟弟突利可汗繼承，突利後來投隋，隋得以逐步削弱汗國。真正決定東突厥命運的並不是某一場會戰：莫何死後，汗族內訌再起，隋與吐蕃分別在東西兩面拉攏各部，鐵勒的勢力坐大，鐵勒系與回鶻的名字逐步取代突厥，最終在唐貞觀年間隨著頗利可汗的敗亡，漠北的汗國為唐朝所併。回頭看587年這一仗，它在草原史上的分量並不在傷亡數字，而在於確立了用追擊與斷絕草水代替正面殲滅這條草原戰爭的邏輯，也讓漢朝與隋唐的北方邊疆史有了一條可以對照的時間線。
resultEn: The outcome at the Yin Mountains was total. Mohe Qaghan won; Apu Qaghan was defeated and fled east to the Tiele; the pursuit ran on into the sandy wastes of the northern desert, where Apu died, and his people and his divisions passed to Mohe. Mohe then took the title of Great Qaghan, gathered in the Tiele tribes, and concentrated the power of the khanate once more in a single khagan and his brother, which was the most complete reunification the Eastern Turks had known since Tuo-jin. But the cost of that reunification is visible in the sources as well: in 595, the fifteenth year of Kaihuang, Mohe asked the Sui to send troops against the Tuyuhun, fell ill and died on the way, and the khanship passed to his brother Tuli Qaghan, who later came over to the Sui, allowing the Sui to weaken the khanate step by step. What really settled the fate of the Eastern Turks was not any single battle: after Mohe's death the internecine strife of the ruling line resumed, the Sui and the Tibetans pulled the various tribes towards themselves from the east and the west, the power of the Tiele grew, the Tiele and Ywei names gradually displaced the Turkic name, and in the Zhenguan years of the Tang, with the defeat of the khagan Jelibozu, the khanate of the northern steppe was absorbed by the Tang court. Looked at from the long run, the weight of the year 587 in steppe history does not lie in casualty figures but in the establishment of the steppe logic of pursuit and the cutting of water and fodder in place of frontal annihilation, and it gives the northern frontier history of the Han, Sui and Tang a line that can be checked against other periods.
